title: Roasted Eggplant & Chickpea Salad
title_ru: Салат из запечённых баклажанов с нутом
summary: Warm or cold salad of roasted eggplant, red peppers and garlic with chickpeas and parsley. Very little oil, high in fiber.

nutrition.basis: per serving (~280 g), without bread and added salt

ingredients.name: Olive oil
ingredients.note: divided: part for roasting, rest for dressing

steps: Preheat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F). Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Prick the whole eggplants with a fork. Cut the top off the garlic head.
Rub the eggplants and peppers lightly with oil. Wrap the garlic in foil with a drop of oil.
Roast everything on a baking sheet for 35–40 minutes, turning halfway. Check the garlic at 25 minutes and remove once soft. Larger eggplants need more time.
Cool until safe to handle. Peel the eggplants and peppers, discard pepper stems and seeds. Drain excess liquid and finely chop the flesh.
Squeeze the garlic out of its skins and mash.
Mix chickpeas, vegetables and garlic. Once slightly cooled, fold in the parsley.
Dress with the remaining oil, salt and pepper, mix well. Serve warm or chilled, with bread or in wraps.
tips: For a juicier salad add 1–2 more tbsp olive oil and juice of half a lemon.
Tastes even better the next day.
Peeled eggplant gives a dip-like texture; keeping the skin adds more smoky flavor.
storage: Refrigerate in an airtight container up to 3 days.

source.note: Quantities and nutrition from the author's blog
